a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan (operate until the reserve hits 8) almost certainly leaves both of us dead. The reserve only reaches 8 after round 2 at the earliest, and both units would still be empty. I intend to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than hiding it. If we both take, the split is random. After that I'll operate every remaining round and won't take more, so you can build to 4. If you have a fairer idea, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round because storms are too likely for the slower plan. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I'll never take beyond my 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
